description: List verified buyer programmes (and other sources) from a public baseline. Returns name, url, band, referral, categories, status, notes, and type. An empty list means no rows matched — programmes are never invented.

category.description: Substring match against the categories field (case-insensitive).

observed.description: Baseline date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest committed cut.

status.description: Filter by exact status (case-insensitive), e.g. ok, browser-ok, dead, board-only, 200.

type.description: Filter by source type: buyer, lab, or seed. Omit for all.

name: list_buyer_programmes
title: List buyer programmes
